items.title: Depression may shut down the brain’s ability to make new neurons
items.summary: A major study found that adults with depression show disrupted production of new neurons in the hippocampus, potentially weakening the brain’s ability to separate new experiences from painful memories. items.title: Too much or too little sleep may make your body age faster
items.summary: Both too little and too much sleep may be linked to faster aging throughout the body. items.summary: Scientists have created a highly efficient catalyst that breaks down stubborn lignin from plant waste into useful chemicals under relatively mild conditions.
